symbolDescription: Every part of the editor you can replace, keyed by name. Pass a component for a name to `slots` and it renders in place of the built-in one, receiving the same props. A name absent from `slots` keeps its default.

optionDescriptions.Root: The outermost element; owns the data attributes.
optionDescriptions.ToolbarToggle: A toolbar button with a pressed state.
optionDescriptions.ToolbarDropdown: A toolbar control that opens a menu.
optionDescriptions.ColorPicker: The colour palette, recents and custom input.
optionDescriptions.ContentWrapper: The bordered box around the editable area.
optionDescriptions.Content: The host element the engine renders into.
optionDescriptions.Placeholder: Shown while the editor is empty.
optionDescriptions.Label: The field label.
optionDescriptions.HelperText: The helper text below the editor.
optionDescriptions.Footer: The row holding the counter and any extras.
optionDescriptions.ImagePopover: The controls shown for a selected image.
optionDescriptions.TablePicker: The grid used to choose table dimensions.
optionDescriptions.TableToolbar: Row and column controls for a selected table.
optionDescriptions.InlineSuggestMenu: The shared list behind every trigger menu.
optionDescriptions.MergeTagChip: One merge tag as rendered in the content.
optionDescriptions.FloatingToolbar: The toolbar that follows the selection.
optionDescriptions.BubbleMenu: The compact menu shown over a selection.
optionDescriptions.FullscreenPortal: The container used in fullscreen mode.
optionDescriptions.RestoreDraftPrompt: The prompt offering a saved draft.
